text:
Cutter Gauthier has 20 points in his last ten games, and the story around him has turned into an argument about the past. Elliotte Friedman reported on the trade that sent him from Philadelphia, and Flyers GM Daniel Briere fired back that Friedman was "Just trying to get some free clicks on it," per the headlines. Meanwhile Gauthier keeps showing up on goal-leader lists. Our numbers call the run earned: the chances are there to support it, even if nobody keeps that pace. He's at 45% to score tonight, the highest on the board for this game.

The rest of Anaheim is less settled. The Ducks are 1-4-0 in their last five, were shut out 4-0 in Colorado on Thursday, and have 46% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of the chances) on the season. Beckett Sennecke (26 points in 22 games) and Ryan Poehling are both on injured reserve, so captain Mikael Granlund, 17 points in his last ten, carries even more of it. The Ducks also sent Laurent Brossoit to the AHL despite a 4-1 record, which tells you how crowded the net is. Ville Husso starts at .857.

Utah is the opposite case: a team playing well enough to be comfortable and getting nothing for it. The Mammoth have 57% of the five-on-five expected goals, among the best in the league, and an even goal difference on +14.9 expected. Their goaltending has allowed 9.5 more goals than the shots deserved, and Sebastian Cossa (.879) starts over Karel Vejmelka. The 4-1 win over Colorado snapped a six-game winless run, and the Mammoth and Avalanche, who have found some bad blood lately, just unveiled their Winter Classic uniforms. Dylan Guenther and Nick Schmaltz are out, which has pushed Vincent Trocheck to about 23 minutes a night. Logan Cooley, 14 points in his last ten, is facing NHL discipline for punching Vancouver's Linus Karlsson while he was down, per the coverage.

Our numbers see a lot of goals: Utah 4.07 expected, Anaheim 3.39. Kailer Yamamoto, new to the top power play, is our sleeper at 53% for a point.
headline: Gauthier's hot streak meets Utah's bad luck
